_comment: Our normal (no-event) rate set for JaRP's cluster. Every value is multiplied by the official event factor; render.mjs multiplies ALL nine, intervals included, so an official '0.5 x Mating Interval' halves our interval. Taming stays vanilla here on purpose: the speed-up lives in Game.ini, not this page (WildDinoCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier=4 makes tamed-in-progress dinos eat faster in real time while the same total food and the same kibble tier still decide the outcome; PassiveTameIntervalMultiplier=0.1 speeds passive tames 10x). 'mode' below is descriptive only and read by no script.
name: JaRPs DynConfig
